<!DOCTYPE html>  
<html lang="vi">  
<head>  
 <meta charset="UTF-8">
 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
 <meta name="theme-color" content="#1A2530">  
 <title>Đổi Sort Code SPX Express</title>  
 <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@600;700&family=Roboto:wght@300;400;700&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">  
 <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">  
 <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>  
 <!-- Thêm thư viện Chart.js cho cấu phần Analytics -->
 <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
 <!-- Thư viện giải mã QR dự phòng cho trình duyệt chưa có BarcodeDetector -->
 <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js"></script>
  
 <style>  
 :root {  
 --spx-orange: #EE4D2D;  
 --spx-orange-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6A4D 0%, #EE4D2D 100%);  
 --spx-dark-bg: #1A2530;  
 --spx-blue-neon: #073763;  
 --spx-light-bg: #F8F9FA;  
 --spx-gray-border: #3A3B3C;  
 --card-bg: #FFFFFF;  
 --text-main: #222222;  
 --text-muted: #777777;  
 --input-bg: #FFFFFF;  
 --input-border: #CCCCCC;  
 --readonly-bg: #FAFAFA;  
 --readonly-border: #EEEEEE;  
 --stt-bg: rgba(26, 37, 48, 0.05);  
 --modal-bg: #FFFFFF;  
 --spx-white: #FFFFFF;  
 --spx-red: #ff3333;  
 --spx-amber: #f39c12;  
 --option-even-bg: #F1F3F5;  
  
 /* Định nghĩa màu sắc cho Retro Flip Clock tối giản */  
 --flip-bg: #1E1F22;   
 --flip-text: #FFFFFF;  
 --flip-groove: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);  
 --flip-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);  
 }  
  
 [data-theme="dark"] {  
 --spx-dark-bg: #0D131A;  
 --spx-light-bg: #121212;   
 --card-bg: #1E1E1E;   
 --text-main: #E0E0E0;   
 --text-muted: #A0A0A0;   
 --input-bg: #2D2D2D;   
 --input-border: #444444;   
 --readonly-bg: #252525;   
 --readonly-border: #333333;  
 --stt-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);   
 --modal-bg: #1E1E1E;   
 --option-even-bg: #2A2A2A;  
 }  
  
 body {  
 font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;  
 margin: 0;  
 padding: 0;  
 background-color: var(--spx-light-bg);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 padding-bottom: 100px;   
 transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;  
 user-select: none;  
 position: relative;
 }  
  
 .header {  
 background: var(--spx-dark-bg);  
 color: var(--spx-white);  
 padding: 15px 30px;  
 box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(26, 37, 48, 0.2);  
 position: sticky;  
 top: 0;  
 z-index: 1000;  
 border-bottom: 4px solid var(--spx-orange);  
 display: flex;  
 justify-content: space-between;  
 align-items: center;  
 transition: background-color 0.3s ease;  
 user-select: auto;  
 }  
  
 .header h1 {  
 margin: 0;  
 font-size: 24px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 letter-spacing: 0.5px;  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 10px;  
 }  
   
 .header h1 span {  
 color: var(--spx-orange);  
 }  
  
 /* STYLE MỚI CHO Ô NHẬP TÌNH/THÀNH PHỐ Ở HEADER TƯƠNG THÍCH GIAO DIỆN CŨ */
 .header-province-container {
 position: relative;
 display: inline-block;
 }

 .header-province-input {  
 background-color: var(--spx-orange);  
 color: var(--spx-white);  
 border: none;  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 font-size: 16px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 padding: 4px 28px 4px 12px;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 outline: none;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s ease;  
 width: 240px;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 }  
 .header-province-input::placeholder {  
 color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);  
 font-size: 16px;
 font-weight: 600;
 }  
 .header-province-input:focus {  
 background-color: #ff6a4d;  
 }  

 .header-province-clear {
 position: absolute;
 right: 8px;
 top: 50%;
 transform: translateY(-50%);
 background: transparent;
 border: none;
 color: white;
 cursor: pointer;
 font-size: 14px;
 display: none;
 padding: 2px;
 z-index: 10;
 }

 .header-province-dropdown {
 display: none;
 position: absolute;
 top: 105%;
 left: 0;
 width: 100%;
 max-height: 455px;
 overflow-y: auto;
 background-color: var(--spx-dark-bg);
 border: 1px solid var(--spx-orange);
 border-radius: 6px;
 z-index: 1001;
 box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
 }

 .header-province-option {
 padding: 8px 12px;
 font-size: 14px;
 font-weight: 600;
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
 color: var(--spx-white);
 cursor: pointer;
 border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
 white-space: nowrap;
 overflow: hidden;
 text-overflow: ellipsis;
 }

 .header-province-option:hover, .header-province-option.active {
 background-color: var(--spx-orange);
 color: #FFFFFF;
 }
  
 .header-right-controls {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 20px;  
 }  

 .user-profile-badge {
 background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
 border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
 padding: 6px 14px;
 border-radius: 30px;
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 8px;
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
 font-size: 13px;
 color: var(--spx-white);
 }

 .user-profile-badge i {
 color: var(--spx-orange);
 }  
  
 .theme-dropdown-container {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 8px;  
 background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);  
 padding: 4px 12px;  
 border-radius: 30px;  
 border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);  
 }  
  
 .theme-dropdown-label {  
 font-size: 11px;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 letter-spacing: 0.5px;  
 color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 4px;  
 }  
  
 .theme-select-menu {  
 background: transparent;  
 color: var(--spx-white);  
 border: none;  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 font-size: 12px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 outline: none;  
 padding: 4px 8px;  
 border-radius: 4px;  
 }  
  
 .theme-select-menu option {  
 background-color: var(--spx-dark-bg);  
 color: var(--spx-white);  
 font-weight: 500;  
 }  
  
 .theme-toggle-btn {  
 background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);  
 border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);  
 color: var(--spx-white);  
 padding: 10px 16px;  
 border-radius: 30px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 font-weight: 600;  
 font-size: 13px;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 8px;  
 transition: all 0.2s ease;  
 }  
  
 .theme-toggle-btn:hover {  
 background: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.5);  
 }  
  
 .flip-clock-wrapper {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 10px;  
 padding: 4px 12px;  
 border-radius: 8px;  
 background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);  
 border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);  
 }  
  
 .flip-clock-label {  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 font-size: 11px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);  
 letter-spacing: 0.5px;  
 margin-right: 2px;  
 display: flex;  
 flex-direction: column;  
 justify-content: center;  
 }  
  
 .flip-clock-container {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 6px;  
 }  
  
 .flip-clock-divider {  
 font-size: 26px;  
 font-weight: 900;  
 color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);  
 animation: flip-divider-blink 1s infinite;  
 margin: 0 -2px;  
 }  
  
 @keyframes flip-divider-blink {  
 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; }  
 50% { opacity: 1; }  
 }  
  
 .flip-card {  
 position: relative;  
 width: 42px;  
 height: 46px;  
 font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Futura, Arial, sans-serif;  
 font-size: 28px;  
 font-weight: bold;  
 color: var(--flip-text);  
 background-color: var(--flip-bg);  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 perspective: 200px;  
 box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);  
 border: 1px solid var(--flip-border);  
 overflow: hidden;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card::after {  
 content: "";  
 position: absolute;  
 top: 50%;  
 left: 0;  
 width: 100%;  
 height: 1.5px;  
 background-color: var(--flip-groove);  
 z-index: 10;  
 box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);  
 z-index: 10;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-part {  
 position: absolute;  
 left: 0;  
 width: 100%;  
 height: 50%;  
 overflow: hidden;  
 display: flex;  
 justify-content: center;  
 align-items: center;  
 backface-visibility: hidden;  
 transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-top {  
 top: 0;  
 align-items: flex-end;  
 transform-origin: center bottom;  
 border-top-left-radius: 6px;  
 border-top-right-radius: 6px;  
 background-color: var(--flip-bg);  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-bottom {  
 bottom: 0;  
 align-items: flex-start;  
 transform-origin: center top;  
 border-bottom-left-radius: 6px;  
 border-bottom-right-radius: 6px;  
 background-color: #1a1b1d;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-inner {  
 position: absolute;  
 width: 100%;  
 height: 100%;  
 display: flex;  
 justify-content: center;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-top .flip-card-inner {  
 top: 0;  
 height: 200%;  
 align-items: center;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card-bottom .flip-card-inner {  
 bottom: 0;  
 height: 200%;  
 align-items: center;  
 }  
  
 .flip-card.animate .flip-card-top {  
 transform: rotateX(-180deg);  
 }  
  
 .container {  
 max-width: 1540px;  
 margin: 25px auto;  
 padding: 0 15px;  
 user-select: auto;  
 }  
  
 .table-actions-wrapper {  
 display: flex;  
 justify-content: space-between;  
 align-items: center;  
 margin-bottom: 12px;  
 }  
  
 .table-actions {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 padding-left: 70px;  
 gap: 12px;  
 }  
  
 .btn-action-synchronized {  
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);  
 padding: 8px 16px;  
 border-radius: 8px;  
 font-size: 13px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 8px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);  
 transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 letter-spacing: 0.3px;  
 background-color: var(--card-bg);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 height: 38px;  
 box-sizing: border-box;  
 }  
  
 .btn-action-synchronized.clear-all-btn:hover {  
 color: white;  
 background-color: var(--spx-red);  
 border-color: var(--spx-red);  
 box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 51, 51, 0.25);  
 }  
  
 .btn-action-synchronized.copy-all-btn {  
 color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 background-color: rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.02);  
 }  
  
 .btn-action-synchronized.copy-all-btn:hover {  
 color: white;  
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.25);  
 }  

 /* NÚT THÊM 10 HÀNG */
 .btn-action-synchronized.add-rows-btn {
 color: #28a745;
 border-color: #28a745;
 background-color: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.04);
 }
 .btn-action-synchronized.add-rows-btn:hover {
 color: white;
 background-color: #28a745;
 border-color: #28a745;
 box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.25);
 }
 /* NÚT DÁN KHU VỰC HÀNG LOẠT (PASTE ALL) */
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn {
   position: relative;
   color: #ffffff;
   border-color: #ff7a00;
   background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7a00 0%, #ff9d2e 100%);
   box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.30);
 }
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:hover {
   background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e86a00 0%, #ff8a14 100%);
   border-color: #e86a00;
   box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.45);
   transform: translateY(-1px);
 }
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:active {
   transform: translateY(0);
 }
 /* Nâng lớp (layer) của thanh nút lên trên bảng để bảng ghi chú không bị che */
 .table-actions-wrapper {
   position: relative;
   z-index: 900;
 }
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:hover,
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:focus-visible {
   z-index: 9100;
 }
 .paste-all-tip {
   position: absolute;
   top: calc(100% + 10px);
   left: 0;
   width: 290px;
   padding: 10px 12px;
   border-radius: 8px;
   border: 1px solid #ff7a00;
   background-color: var(--card-bg);
   color: var(--text-main);
   box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
   font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
   font-size: 12px;
   font-weight: 500;
   line-height: 1.5;
   text-transform: none;
   letter-spacing: 0;
   text-align: left;
   white-space: normal;
   opacity: 0;
   visibility: hidden;
   pointer-events: none;
   transform: translateY(-4px);
   transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, visibility 0.2s;
   z-index: 9200;
 }
 .paste-all-tip::before {
   content: '';
   position: absolute;
   top: -6px;
   left: 22px;
   width: 10px;
   height: 10px;
   background-color: var(--card-bg);
   border-left: 1px solid #ff7a00;
   border-top: 1px solid #ff7a00;
   transform: rotate(45deg);
 }
 .paste-all-tip b {
   display: block;
   margin-bottom: 4px;
   font-size: 12px;
   font-weight: 800;
   color: #ff7a00;
   text-transform: uppercase;
   letter-spacing: 0.3px;
 }
 .paste-all-tip em {
   display: block;
   margin-top: 6px;
   font-style: normal;
   font-size: 11px;
   color: var(--text-main);
   opacity: 0.75;
 }
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:hover .paste-all-tip,
 .btn-action-synchronized.paste-all-btn:focus-visible .paste-all-tip {
   opacity: 1;
   visibility: visible;
   transform: translateY(0);
 }
 @media (hover: none) {
   .paste-all-tip { display: none; }
 }
 .row-count-badge {
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 min-width: 78px;
 height: 38px;
 padding: 0 12px;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);
 border-radius: 8px;
 background: var(--card-bg);
 color: var(--text-main);
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
 font-size: 12px;
 font-weight: 700;
 white-space: nowrap;
 }


 /* CONTAINER CHỨA CÁC NÚT ĐIỀU KHIỂN BÊN PHẢI (AUTOSCROLL + THU PHÓNG) */
 .table-right-controls-group {
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 12px;
 }

 /* CSS TỰ ĐỒNG BỘ CHO NÚT AUTO-SCROLL TOGGLE SWITCH */
 .autoscroll-toggle-container {
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 8px;
 background-color: var(--card-bg);
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);
 padding: 0 14px;
 border-radius: 8px;
 box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
 height: 38px;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 cursor: pointer;
 user-select: none;
 }

 .autoscroll-toggle-label {
 font-size: 12px;
 font-weight: 700;
 color: var(--text-main);
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
 text-transform: uppercase;
 letter-spacing: 0.3px;
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 6px;
 }

 .autoscroll-switch {
 position: relative;
 display: inline-block;
 width: 36px;
 height: 20px;
 }

 .autoscroll-switch input {
 opacity: 0;
 width: 0;
 height: 0;
 }

 .autoscroll-slider {
 position: absolute;
 cursor: pointer;
 top: 0;
 left: 0;
 right: 0;
 bottom: 0;
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);
 transition: .3s;
 border-radius: 20px;
 }

 .autoscroll-slider:before {
 position: absolute;
 content: "";
 height: 14px;
 width: 14px;
 left: 2px;
 bottom: 2px;
 background-color: var(--text-muted);
 transition: .3s;
 border-radius: 50%;
 }

 input:checked + .autoscroll-slider {
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);
 }

 input:checked + .autoscroll-slider:before {
 transform: translateX(16px);
 background-color: #FFFFFF;
 }
  
 .table-zoom-controls {  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 8px;  
 background-color: var(--card-bg);  
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);  
 padding: 0 14px;  
 border-radius: 8px;  
 box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);  
 height: 38px;  
 box-sizing: border-box;  
 }  
  
 .table-zoom-controls span {  
 font-size: 12px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 letter-spacing: 0.3px;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 6px;  
 }  
  
 .btn-zoom {  
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);  
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 width: 26px;  
 height: 26px;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 justify-content: center;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 font-size: 11px;  
 font-weight: bold;  
 transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);  
 }  
  
 .btn-zoom:hover {  
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 color: white;  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.2);  
 }  
  
 .zoom-percentage-text {  
 font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 min-width: 48px;  
 text-align: center;  
 color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 cursor: pointer;  
 padding: 2px 6px;  
 border-radius: 4px;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s;  
 }  
  
 .zoom-percentage-text:hover {  
 background-color: rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.08);  
 }  
  
 .card {  
 background: var(--card-bg);  
 border-radius: 12px;  
 overflow: visible;  
 box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);  
 border: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.15);  
 margin-bottom: 30px;   
 transition: background-color 0.3s ease;  
 transform-origin: top left;  
 transition: transform 0.2s ease-out;  
 display: flex;  
 flex-direction: column;  
 position: relative;
 }  
  
 .table-wrapper {  
 overflow-x: auto;  
 overflow-y: auto;  
 height: 690px;   
 min-height: 250px;   
 max-height: 1200px;   
 border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.1);  
 position: relative;
 }  
  
 .table-resize-handler {  
 height: 16px;  
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);  
 border-top: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.15);  
 cursor: ns-resize;  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 justify-content: center;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s ease;  
 position: relative;  
 }  
  
 .table-resize-handler:hover, .table-resize-handler.active {  
 background-color: rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.1);  
 }  
  
 .table-resize-handler::before {  
 content: "";  
 width: 40px;  
 height: 4px;  
 border-radius: 2px;  
 background-color: var(--text-muted);  
 opacity: 0.5;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;  
 }  
  
 .table-resize-handler:hover::before, .table-resize-handler.active::before {  
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 opacity: 1;  
 }  
  
 table {  
 width: 100%;  
 border-collapse: collapse;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 text-align: left;  
 position: relative;
 }  
  
 thead {  
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 color: white;  
 position: sticky;  
 top: 0;  
 z-index: 10;  
 }  
  
 th {  
 font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;  
 padding: 16px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 white-space: nowrap;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 letter-spacing: 0.3px;  
 }  
  
 th.stt-col, td.stt-col {  
 text-align: center;  
 width: 60px;  
 font-weight: bold;  
 background-color: var(--stt-bg);   
 color: var(--text-main);  
 border-right: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.15);  
 transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;  
 }  
  
 td {  
 padding: 4px 8px;  
 border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.1);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 transition: border-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;  
 position: relative;  
 }  

 td.selectable-cell {
   cursor: cell;
 }

 #selectionOverlayBox {
   position: fixed;
   border: 1.5px dashed #0078d4;
   background-color: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.18);
   pointer-events: none;
   z-index: 99999;
   display: none;
   border-radius: 2px;
   box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.3);
 }

 .highlighted-selection-cell {
   background-color: rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.25) !important;
   outline: 1.5px solid #0078d4 !important;
   outline-offset: -1.5px;
 }

 .input-tracking, .input-suggest, .readonly-box {  
   user-select: text !important;  
   -webkit-user-drag: none !important;  
 }  
  
 .input-tracking {  
 width: 100%;  
 padding: 8px 12px;  
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 background-color: var(--input-bg);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 box-sizing: border-box;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 text-transform: uppercase;  
 transition: all 0.2s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;  
 }  
 .input-tracking:focus {  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.15);  
 outline: none;  
 }  
  
 .suggest-input-wrapper {
   position: relative;
   width: 100%;
   display: flex;
   align-items: center;
 }

 .input-suggest {  
 width: 100%;  
 padding: 8px 30px 8px 12px;  
 border: 1px solid var(--input-border);  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 background-color: var(--input-bg);  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 font-size: 14px;  
 box-sizing: border-box;  
 transition: all 0.2s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;  
 }  
 .input-suggest:focus:not(:disabled) {  
 border-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 outline: none;  
 }  
 .input-suggest:disabled {  
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);  
 color: var(--text-muted);  
 cursor: not-allowed;  
 border-color: var(--readonly-border);  
 }  

 .btn-clear-suggest {
   position: absolute;
   right: 8px;
   background: none;
   border: none;
   color: var(--text-muted);
   cursor: pointer;
   font-size: 14px;
   padding: 2px 6px;
   display: none;
   align-items: center;
   justify-content: center;
   border-radius: 50%;
   transition: all 0.2s ease;
   z-index: 5;
 }
 .btn-clear-suggest:hover {
   color: var(--spx-orange);
   background-color: rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.1);
 }
  
 .suggest-dropdown {
   display: none;
   position: absolute;
   top: 100%;
   left: 0;
   width: 320px;
   max-height: 500px;
   overflow-y: auto;
   background-color: var(--card-bg);
   border: 1px solid var(--input-border);
   border-radius: 6px;
   z-index: 1000;
   box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
   resize: both;
   overscroll-behavior: contain;
 }

 .suggest-option {
   padding: 10px 14px;
   cursor: pointer;
   font-size: 13px;
   color: var(--text-main);
   border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58, 59, 60, 0.05);
   white-space: nowrap;
   overflow: hidden;
   text-overflow: ellipsis;
   transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
 }

 .suggest-option:nth-child(even) {
   background-color: var(--option-even-bg);
 }

 .suggest-option:hover, 
 .suggest-option:nth-child(even):hover, 
 .suggest-option.active {
   background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon) !important;
   color: white !important;
 }
  
 .readonly-box {  
 padding: 8px 12px;  
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);  
 border: 1px solid var(--readonly-border);  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 min-height: 20px;  
 font-weight: 500;  
 transition: background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;  
 }  
  
 .sort-code-output {  
 color: var(--spx-orange);  
 font-weight: 700;  
 background-color: rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.05);  
 border: 1px dashed rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.4);  
 letter-spacing: 0.5px;  
 }  
  
 .action-col-cell {  
 display: flex;  
 gap: 6px;  
 justify-content: center;  
 align-items: center;  
 }  
  
 .btn-row-action {  
 border: none;  
 background: none;  
 padding: 5px 10px;  
 border-radius: 4px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 font-size: 13px;  
 transition: all 0.2s;  
 display: inline-flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 4px;  
 }  
  
 .btn-row-copy {

 }  
 .btn-row-copy:hover {

 }  
  
 .btn-row-paste {

 }

 }  
 .btn-row-paste:disabled {

 .btn-row-delete {

 }

 }  
  
 .history-card {  
 background: var(--card-bg);

 .history-header-flex {

 .history-title i { color: var(--spx-orange); }  
  
 .btn-clear-session {  
 background-color: transparent;  
 border: 1px solid var(--spx-red);  
 color: var(--spx-red);  
 padding: 6px 14px;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 font-size: 12px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 cursor: pointer;

 .dashboard-grid {

 .analytics-section {

 .analytics-title {

 .summary-total-container {

 .history-table-wrapper {

 .history-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background-color: var(--card-bg); }  
  
 .history-table th {

 .btn-history-action {

 .btn-history-action.download:hover {

 .btn-history-action.delete:hover {

 background-color: var(--spx-red);  
 border-color: var(--spx-red);  
 }  
  
 .badge-count {  
 background-color: rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.1);  
 color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 padding: 5px 12px;  
 border-radius: 20px;

 font-size: 13px;  
 border: 1px solid rgba(31, 117, 254, 0.2);

 .badge-count:hover {

 .badge-time {

 .no-history {

 .tracking-list-area {  
 background-color: var(--readonly-bg);  
 border: 1px solid var(--readonly-border);  
 border-radius: 8px;  
 padding: 12px;

 overflow-y: auto;  
 text-align: left;  
 font-family: monospace;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 line-height: 1.6;

 word-break: break-all;  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 }  
  
 .btn-copy-action {  
 background-color: var(--spx-orange);  
 color: white;  
 border: none;  
 padding: 10px 20px;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 display: inline-flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 6px;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s;  
 margin-right: 10px;  
 }  
  
 .btn-copy-action:hover { background-color: #d63b1d; }  
  
 .fixed-action-btn {  
 position: fixed;  
 bottom: 30px;  
 right: 30px;  
 z-index: 2000;  
 }  
  
 .btn-done {  
 background: var(--spx-orange-gradient);  
 color: white;  
 border: none;  
 padding: 15px 32px;  
 font-size: 16px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 border-radius: 50px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.4);  
 display: flex;  
 align-items: center;  
 gap: 8px;  
 transition: all 0.2s ease;  
 }  
  
 .btn-done:hover {

 box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.55);  
 }  
  
 .modal-overlay {  
 position: fixed;  
 top: 0;  
 left: 0;  
 width: 100%;  
 height: 100%;  
 background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);  
 backdrop-filter: blur(5px);   
 z-index: 9999;  
 display: flex;  
 justify-content: center;  
 align-items: center;  
 opacity: 0;  
 pointer-events: none;  
 transition: opacity 0.3s ease;  
 }  
  
 .modal-overlay.active {  
 opacity: 1;  
 pointer-events: auto;  
 }  
  
 .modal-box {  
 background-color: var(--modal-bg);  
 padding: 35px;  
 border-radius: 16px;  
 box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);  
 text-align: center;  
 max-width: 420px;  
 width: 90%;  
 transform: scale(0.85);  
 transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275), background-color 0.3s ease;  
 border-top: 5px solid var(--spx-orange);  
 }  
  
 .modal-overlay.active .modal-box {  
 transform: scale(1);  
 }  
  
 .modal-icon {  
 font-size: 64px;  
 margin-bottom: 18px;  
 animation: pulse-glow 1.5s infinite alternate;  
 }  
  
 .icon-alert { color: var(--spx-orange); }  
 .icon-confirm { color: var(--spx-amber); }   
  
 @keyframes pulse-glow {  
 0% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.2)); }  
 100% { transform: scale(1.08); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.5)); }  
 }  
  
 .modal-text {  
 font-size: 18px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 color: var(--text-main);  
 margin-bottom: 25px;  
 line-height: 1.4;  
 }  
  
 .modal-btn {  
 background-color: var(--spx-blue-neon);  
 color: white;  
 border: none;  
 padding: 11px 28px;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s;  
 }  
 .modal-btn:hover { background-color: #0056b3; }  
  
 .btn-danger-action {  
 background-color: var(--spx-red);  
 color: white;  
 border: none;  
 padding: 11px 28px;  
 font-size: 14px;  
 font-weight: 700;  
 border-radius: 6px;  
 cursor: pointer;  
 transition: background-color 0.2s;  
 margin-right: 10px;  
 }

 .footer {

 .webmaster-sig {

 .webmaster-sig a {

 }

 }  

 /* ===== QR: NÚT QUÉT TRONG Ô SPX TRACKING NUMBER ===== */
 .tracking-input-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; }
 .tracking-input-wrapper .input-tracking { flex: 1 1 auto; width: auto; min-width: 0; }
 .btn-scan-qr {
 flex: 0 0 auto; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 6px;
 border: 1px solid rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.4); background-color: rgba(238, 77, 45, 0.08);
 color: var(--spx-orange); cursor: pointer; font-size: 17px;
 display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.2s ease; padding: 0;
 }
 .btn-scan-qr:hover, .btn-scan-qr:active { background-color: var(--spx-orange); color: #fff; }

 /* ===== QR: KHUNG CAMERA QUÉT ===== */
 .qr-overlay {
 position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 10000;
 background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
 opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; user-select: none;
 }
 .qr-overlay.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
 .qr-box {
 width: 100%; max-width: 520px; height: 100%; max-height: 100dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
 background: #0D131A; color: #fff; padding: env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
 box-sizing: border-box;
 }
 @media (min-width: 769px) { .qr-box { height: auto; max-height: 92vh; border-radius: 16px; border-top: 5px solid var(--spx-orange); } }
 .qr-topbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; }
 .qr-title i { color: var(--spx-orange); margin-right: 6px; }
 .qr-icon-btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border: none; color: #fff; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; }
 .qr-view { position: relative; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 280px; background: #000; overflow: hidden; }
 .qr-view video { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
 .qr-frame { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 68%; max-width: 300px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
 border: 3px solid var(--spx-orange); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(0,0,0,0.45); pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
 .qr-line { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: var(--spx-orange); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--spx-orange); animation: qr-scan-move 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
 @keyframes qr-scan-move { 0% { top: 4%; } 50% { top: 94%; } 100% { top: 4%; } }
 .qr-error { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 22px; text-align: center; background: rgba(13,19,26,0.96); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
 .qr-error b { color: var(--spx-orange); }
 .qr-status { padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; min-height: 20px; }
 .qr-status.ok { color: #4cd964; }
 .qr-status.warn { color: #ffcc00; }
 .qr-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
 .qr-btn { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
 color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; }
 .qr-btn.on { background: var(--spx-orange); border-color: var(--spx-orange); }
 .qr-continuous { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px 14px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
 .qr-continuous input { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

 /* ===== GIAO DIỆN ĐIỆN THOẠI ===== */
 html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
 @media (max-width: 768px) {
 body { padding-bottom: 96px; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
 .header { position: relative; padding: 10px 12px; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; }
 .header h1 { font-size: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
 .header-province-container { flex: 1 1 100%; }
 .header-province-input { width: 100%; font-size: 16px; padding: 9px 32px 9px 12px; }
 .header-province-dropdown { max-height: 50vh; }
 .header-province-option { padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; }
 .header-right-controls { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between; }
 .user-profile-badge { flex: 1 1 100%; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; min-width: 0; }
 #userEmailTxt { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
 .theme-dropdown-label { display: none; }
 .theme-dropdown-container { padding: 2px 8px; }
 .theme-select-menu { font-size: 13px; }
 .theme-toggle-btn { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
 .flip-clock-wrapper { padding: 3px 8px; gap: 6px; }
 .flip-clock-label { display: none; }
 .flip-card { width: 30px; height: 36px; font-size: 21px; }
 .flip-clock-divider { font-size: 20px; }

 .container { margin: 12px auto; padding: 0 10px; }
 .table-actions-wrapper { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; }
 .table-actions { padding-left: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
 .btn-action-synchronized { flex: 1 1 auto; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; height: 42px; }
 .row-count-badge { height: 42px; }
 .table-right-controls-group { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
 .autoscroll-toggle-container { flex: 1 1 100%; height: 42px; justify-content: space-between; }
 .table-zoom-controls { display: none; }
 .card { zoom: 1 !important; margin-bottom: 20px; }
 .table-wrapper { height: 70vh; height: 70dvh; min-height: 300px; max-height: none; overflow-x: hidden; }
 .table-resize-handler { display: none; }

 /* Bảng chuyển thành dạng thẻ (card) theo từng hàng */
 #dataTable, #dataTable tbody { display: block; width: 100%; }
 #dataTable thead { display: none; }
 #dataTable tbody tr { display: block; position: relative; width: auto; margin: 10px 8px; padding: 10px 12px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--card-bg); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
 #dataTable tbody td { display: block; width: auto !important; padding: 4px 0; border: none; text-align: left; }
 #dataTable tbody td[data-label]::before { content: attr(data-label); display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 3px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; }
 #dataTable tbody td.stt-col { display: inline-block; background: var(--spx-orange); color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2px 12px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
 #dataTable tbody td[data-label="Xóa hàng"] { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; padding: 0; }
 #dataTable tbody td[data-label="Xóa hàng"]::before { display: none; }
 .action-col-cell { justify-content: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
 .btn-row-action { padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 15px; }
 .input-tracking, .input-suggest { font-size: 16px; padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; min-height: 44px; }
 .input-suggest { padding-right: 38px; }
 .btn-scan-qr { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 19px; }
 .btn-clear-suggest { padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 18px; }
 .readonly-box { min-height: 24px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 15px; }
 .suggest-dropdown { width: 100%; max-height: 240px; resize: none; }
 .suggest-option { padding: 13px 14px; font-size: 14px; }

 .history-card { padding: 14px; }
 .history-header-flex { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; }
 .history-title { font-size: 14px; }
 .btn-clear-session { justify-content: center; padding: 10px 14px; }
 .summary-total-container { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; }
 .analytics-section { min-height: 220px; }

 .fixed-action-btn { right: 14px; bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
 .btn-done { padding: 13px 24px; font-size: 15px; }
 .modal-box { padding: 22px 16px; width: 92%; }
 .modal-text { font-size: 16px; }
 .modal-icon { font-size: 48px; }
 .tracking-list-area { max-height: 40vh; }
 .btn-copy-action, .modal-btn, .btn-danger-action { margin: 4px; }
 .footer { padding: 20px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
 }
 @media (max-width: 380px) { .header h1 { font-size: 14px; } .flip-card { width: 26px; height: 32px; font-size: 18px; } }
 </style>  
</head>  
<body>  

 <!-- THẺ OVERLAY PHỤC VỤ VẼ KHUNG CHỌN SELECTION BOX BẰNG KÉO THẢ CHUỘT -->
 <div id="selectionOverlayBox"></div>

 <div class="header">  
 <h1>  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-boxes-packing"></i> Đổi Sort Code   
 <div class="header-province-container">
   <input type="text" class="header-province-input" id="headerProvinceInput" placeholder="Đang tải..." autocomplete="off"
          onfocus="showProvinceDropdown()" oninput="filterProvinceDropdown()">
   <button class="header-province-clear" id="headerProvinceClearBtn" onclick="clearProvinceSelection()" title="Xóa chọn Tỉnh"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
   <div class="header-province-dropdown" id="headerProvinceDropdown"></div>
 </div> — <span>SPX Express</span>  
 </h1>  
   
 <div class="header-right-controls">  
 <div class="user-profile-badge" id="userProfileDisplay">  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-user"></i> <span id="userEmailTxt">Loading user...</span>  
 </div>  

 <div class="theme-dropdown-container">  
 <span class="theme-dropdown-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-palette"></i> Giao diện:</span>  
 <select class="theme-select-menu" id="themeSelectMenu" onchange="handleThemeSelectChange()">  
 <option value="default">Mặc định (Gốc)</option>  
 <option value="ecommerce">E-com (Xanh mint)</option>  
 <option value="sunset">Sunset (Cam đất)</option>  
 <option value="retro">Retro (Hoài cổ)</option>  
 <option value="cyber">Cyber (Tương lai)</option>  
 <option value="monochrome">Elegant (Tinh tế)</option>  
 </select>  
 </div>  
  
 <button class="theme-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleTheme()" id="themeToggleBtn">  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i> Chế độ Tối  
 </button>  
  
 <div class="flip-clock-wrapper">  
 <div class="flip-clock-label">  
 <span style="font-size: 8px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 1px;">RETRO</span>  
 <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--spx-orange);">FLIP</span>  
 </div>  
 <div class="flip-clock-container">  
 <div class="flip-card" id="flip-h1">  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-top"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-bottom"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 </div>  
 <div class="flip-card" id="flip-h2">  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-top"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-bottom"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="flip-clock-divider">:</div>  
  
 <div class="flip-card" id="flip-m1">  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-top"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-bottom"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 </div>  
 <div class="flip-card" id="flip-m2">  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-top"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 <div class="flip-card-part flip-card-bottom"><div class="flip-card-inner">0</div></div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="container">  
 <div class="table-actions-wrapper">  
 <div class="table-actions">  
 <button class="btn-action-synchronized clear-all-btn" onclick="openConfirmModal('clearRows')">  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i> Xóa hết hàng  
 </button>  
 <button class="btn-action-synchronized copy-all-btn" onclick="copyAllTrackings()">  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-copy"></i> Sao chép tất cả mã  
 </button>  
 <button class="btn-action-synchronized add-rows-btn" onclick="addRows(ROW_INCREMENT)" title="Mỗi lần bấm thêm 10 hàng">
 <i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i> Thêm 10 hàng
 </button>
 <button type="button" class="btn-action-synchronized paste-all-btn" id="pasteAllBtn" onclick="pasteAllLocations()">
 <i class="fa-solid fa-paste"></i> Dán khu vực hàng loạt
 <span class="paste-all-tip">
 <b><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-info"></i> Dán khu vực hàng loạt</b>
 Dán Hub Name + Ward đã copy vào TẤT CẢ các hàng đã nhập SPX Tracking Number nhưng chưa có Hub/Ward. Hàng đã có sẵn Hub/Ward sẽ được giữ nguyên. Sort Code New tự động cập nhật theo.
 <em>Cách dùng: bấm nút Copy ở 1 hàng bất kỳ trước, rồi bấm nút này.</em>
 </span>
 </button>

 <span class="row-count-badge" id="rowCountBadge">100 hàng</span>
 </div>  

 <div class="table-right-controls-group">
   <!-- NÚT TOGGLE ON/OFF CHO TÍNH NĂNG TỰ ĐỘNG CUỘN CÙNG HÀNG VÀ PHÍA TRƯỚC THU PHÓNG -->
   <div class="autoscroll-toggle-container" title="Bật/Tắt tính năng tự động cuộn bảng khi nhập liệu">
     <span class="autoscroll-toggle-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrows-up-down"></i> Auto-scroll:</span>
     <label class="autoscroll-switch">
       <input type="checkbox" id="autoScrollToggle" checked>
       <span class="autoscroll-slider"></span>
     </label>
   </div>

   <div class="table-zoom-controls">  
   <span><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass-plus"></i> Thu phóng bảng:</span>  
   <button class="btn-zoom" onclick="adjustTableZoom(-10)" title="Thu nhỏ 10%"><i class="fa-solid fa-minus"></i></button>  
   <div class="zoom-percentage-text" id="zoomVal" onclick="resetTableZoom()" title="Click để reset về 100%">100%</div>  
   <button class="btn-zoom" onclick="adjustTableZoom(10)" title="Phóng to 10%"><i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button>  
   </div>  
 </div>
 </div>  
  
 <div class="card" id="tableCard">  
 <div class="table-wrapper" id="tableWrapper">  
 <table id="dataTable">  
 <thead>  
 <tr>  
 <th class="stt-col" style="font-family: inherit; color: white;">STT</th>  
 <th style="width: 20%;">SPX Tracking Number</th>  
 <th style="width: 23%;">Hub Name</th>  
 <th style="width: 20%;">Ward</th>  
 <th style="width: 12%; text-align: center;">Action</th>  
 <th style="width: 17%;">Sort Code New</th>  
 <th style="width: 8%; text-align: center;">Xóa hàng</th>  
 </tr>  
 </thead>  
 <tbody id="tableBody"></tbody>  
 </table>  
 </div>  
 <div class="table-resize-handler" id="tableResizer" title="Kéo lên/xuống để chỉnh chiều cao bảng"></div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="history-card">  
 <div class="history-header-flex">  
 <h3 class="history-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-pie"></i> LỊCH SỬ XUẤT FILE ĐÃ TẢI &amp; ANALYTICS</h3>  
 <button class="btn-clear-session" onclick="openConfirmModal('clearSession')"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate"></i> Clear Session History</button>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="dashboard-grid">  
   <!-- Phân hệ Analytics Chart -->  
   <div class="analytics-section">  
     <div class="analytics-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-column" style="color:var(--spx-orange)"></i> Volume by Hub (Current Session)</div>  
     <div class="chart-container">  
       <canvas id="hubAnalyticsChart"></canvas>  
     </div>  
   </div>  
  
   <!-- Phân hệ Tóm tắt tích lũy & Bảng dữ liệu tương tác -->  
   <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px;">  
     <div class="summary-total-container">  
       <span class="summary-total-text"><i class="fa-solid fa-chart-line" style="color:var(--spx-blue-neon); margin-right:6px;"></i> Tổng mã đơn hàng đã đổi Sort Code thành công:</span>  
       <span class="summary-total-number" id="accumulatedTotal">0</span>  
     </div>  
     <div class="history-table-wrapper" id="historyContent">  
       <div class="no-history">Chưa có tệp dữ liệu nào được xuất trong phiên làm việc này.</div>  
     </div>  
   </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="fixed-action-btn">  
 <button class="btn-done" onclick="exportToExcel()">  
 <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Xong  
 </button>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="modal-overlay" id="customAlertModal">  
 <div class="modal-box">  
 <div class="modal-icon icon-alert"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation"></i></div>  
 <div class="modal-text" id="modalAlertMessage">Vui lòng điền đầy đủ thông tin</div>  
 <button class="modal-btn" onclick="closeAlertModal()">Xác nhận</button>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="modal-overlay" id="trackingListModal">  
 <div class="modal-box" style="max-width: 500px;">  
 <div style="font-size:24px; color:var(--spx-blue-neon); margin-bottom:12px;"><i class="fa-solid fa-list"></i></div>  
 <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px;" id="trackingModalTitle">Danh sách mã đơn hàng</div>  
 <div class="tracking-list-area" id="trackingListContainer"></div>  
 <button class="btn-copy-action" onclick="copyTrackingToClipboard()"><i class="fa-solid fa-copy"></i> Copy danh sách</button>  
 <button class="modal-btn" onclick="closeTrackingModal()">Đóng</button>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
  
 <div class="modal-overlay" id="customConfirmModal">  
 <div class="modal-box" style="border-top: 5px solid var(--spx-amber);">  
 <div class="modal-icon icon-confirm"><i class="fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation"></i></div>  
 <div class="modal-text" id="confirmModalText">Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa sạch dữ liệu của cả 100 hàng không?</div>  
 <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;">  
 <button class="btn-danger-action" id="confirmModalBtn" onclick="confirmClearAll()">Xóa sạch</button>  
 <button class="modal-btn" onclick="closeConfirmModal()">Hủy bỏ</button>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
 </div>  
  
 <!-- ===== MODAL QUÉT QR BẰNG CAMERA ===== -->
 <div class="qr-overlay" id="qrScannerModal">
 <div class="qr-box">
 <div class="qr-topbar">
 <div class="qr-title"><i class="fa-solid fa-qrcode"></i> Quét QR - Hàng <b id="qrRowLabel">1</b></div>
 <button type="button" class="qr-icon-btn" onclick="closeQrScanner()" title="Đóng"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
 </div>
 <div class="qr-view">
 <video id="qrVideo" playsinline muted autoplay></video>
 <div class="qr-frame"><span class="qr-line"></span></div>
 <div class="qr-error" id="qrError"></div>
 </div>
 <div class="qr-status" id="qrStatus">Đưa mã QR vào giữa khung</div>
 <div class="qr-controls">
 <button type="button" class="qr-btn" id="qrTorchBtn" onclick="toggleQrTorch()" style="display:none;"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt"></i> Đèn</button>
 <button type="button" class="qr-btn" onclick="switchQrCamera()"><i class="fa-solid fa-camera-rotate"></i> Đổi camera</button>
 <label class="qr-btn"><i class="fa-solid fa-image"></i> Chụp / chọn ảnh<input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" id="qrFileInput" onchange="handleQrFile(this)" hidden></label>
 </div>
 <label class="qr-continuous"><input type="checkbox" id="qrContinuousToggle"> Quét liên tục (tự sang hàng kế tiếp)</label>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="footer">  
 <div>© 2026 SPX Express Logistics Tool | Hub Operational System <span id="project-name-display" style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--spx-blue-neon); margin-left: 5px;"></span></div>  
 <span class="webmaster-sig"><i class="fa-solid fa-user-gear"></i> Webmaster: <a href="mailto:toan.nguyenanh@spxexpress.com">toan.nguyenanh@spxexpress.com</a></span>  
 </div>  
  
 <!-- ÂM THANH TING KHI ENTER Ở CỘT SPX TRACKING NUMBER (file ting_spx.mp3 nhúng dạng base64) -->
 <audio id="tingSpxAudio" preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>

 <script>  
  // ========================================================================
  // CẤU HÌNH SỐ DÒNG BẢNG - MẶC ĐỊNH 100, MỖI LẦN THÊM 10 DÒNG
  // ========================================================================
  const DEFAULT_ROW_COUNT = 100;
  const ROW_INCREMENT = 10;
  let currentRowCount = DEFAULT_ROW_COUNT;

  let database = [];   
  let hubMap = {};   
  let exportHistory = [];   
 let localCopiedData = { hub: "", ward: "" };  
 let currentZoomLevel = 100;  
 let hubChart = null; 
 let confirmActionType = ""; 
 
 // Danh sách quản lý Tỉnh/Thành phố cho Ô tìm kiếm Header
 let provinceList = [];
 let selectedHeaderProvince = "";
 
 // Biến cấu trúc State Session cho phần Architect Requirement
 let sessionStartTime = new Date().toISOString();
 let userGmailAddress = "Unknown User";

 // CÁC BIẾN CẤU TRÚC CHO TÍNH NĂNG VÙNG CHỌN (DRAG SELECTION OVERLAY)
 let isSelectingBox = false;
 let startBoxPoint = { x: 0, y: 0 };
 let selectedElements = []; 
  
 const themes = {  
 ecommerce: {  
 '--spx-orange': '#00BFA5',  
 '--spx-orange-gradient': 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7337 0%, #00BFA5 100%)',  
 '--spx-blue-neon': '#00BFA5',  
 '--spx-dark-bg': '#2C3E50',  
 '--spx-light-bg': '#F8F9FA'  
 },  
 sunset: {  
 '--spx-orange': '#EE4D2D',  
 '--spx-orange-gradient': 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7F50 0%, #EE4D2D 100%)',  
 '--spx-blue-neon': '#F3A333',  
 '--spx-dark-bg': '#900C3F',  
 '--spx-light-bg': '#FFF5E1'  
 },  
 retro: {  
 '--spx-orange': '#EE4D2D',  
 '--spx-orange-gradient': 'linear-gradient(135deg, #E6C280 0%, #EE4D2D 100%)',  
 '--spx-blue-neon': '#4A5B5C',  
 '--spx-dark-bg': '#2B2B2B',  
 '--spx-light-bg': '#D9C3B0'  
 },  
 cyber: {  
 '--spx-orange': '#EE4D2D',  
 '--spx-orange-gradient': 'linear-gradient(135deg, #8A2BE2 0%, #EE4D2D 100%)',  
 '--spx-blue-neon': '#00FFFF',  
 '--spx-dark-bg': '#120E2E',  
 '--spx-light-bg': '#FFFFFF'  
 },  
 monochrome: {  
 '--spx-orange': '#EE4D2D',  
 '--spx-orange-gradient': 'linear-gradient(135deg, #B33219 0%, #EE4D2D 100%)',  
 '--spx-blue-neon': '#FF7A5A',  
 '--spx-dark-bg': '#FFA488',  
 '--spx-light-bg': '#FFF0EC'  
 }  
 };  
  
 function handleThemeSelectChange() {  
 const selectedTheme = document.getElementById("themeSelectMenu").value;  
 selectTheme(selectedTheme);  
 }  
  
 function selectTheme(themeKey) {  
 const root = document.documentElement;  
 if (themeKey === "default" || !themes[themeKey]) {  
 root.style.removeProperty('--spx-orange');  
 root.style.removeProperty('--spx-orange-gradient');  
 root.style.removeProperty('--spx-blue-neon');  
 root.style.removeProperty('--spx-dark-bg');  
 root.style.removeProperty('--spx-light-bg');  
 return;  
 }  
  
 const themeData = themes[themeKey];  
 for (const key in themeData) {  
 root.style.setProperty(key, themeData[key]);  
 }  
 }  
  
 function toggleTheme() {  
 const body = document.body;  
 const btn = document.getElementById("themeToggleBtn");  
 if (body.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark") {  
 body.removeAttribute("data-theme");  
 btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i> Chế độ Tối';  
 } else {  
 body.setAttribute("data-theme", "dark");  
 btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i> Chế độ Sáng';  
 }  
 }  
  
 let lastTime = { h1: '', h2: '', m1: '', m2: '' };  
  
 function updateFlipCard(cardId, newValue) {  
 const card = document.getElementById(cardId);  
 if (!card) return;  
  
 const topPart = card.querySelector('.flip-card-top');  
 const bottomPart = card.querySelector('.flip-card-bottom');  
  
 if (lastTime[cardId] === newValue) return;  
  
 card.classList.add('animate');  
  
 setTimeout(() => {  
 topPart.querySelector('.flip-card-inner').innerText = newValue;  
 bottomPart.querySelector('.flip-card-inner').innerText = newValue;  
 card.classList.remove('animate');  
 }, 450);  
  
 lastTime[cardId] = newValue;  
 }  
  
 function updateRetroClock() {  
 const now = new Date();  
 let hours = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');  
 let minutes = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');  
  
 updateFlipCard('flip-h1', hours[0]);  
 updateFlipCard('flip-h2', hours[1]);  
 updateFlipCard('flip-m1', minutes[0]);  
 updateFlipCard('flip-m2', minutes[1]);  
 }  
  
 function adjustTableZoom(amount) {  
 let newZoom = currentZoomLevel + amount;  
 if (newZoom >= 60 && newZoom <= 140) {  
 currentZoomLevel = newZoom;  
 applyZoom();  
 }  
 }  
  
 function resetTableZoom() {  
 currentZoomLevel = 100;  
 applyZoom();  
 }  
  
 function applyZoom() {  
 const tableCard = document.getElementById("tableCard");  
 const zoomValText = document.getElementById("zoomVal");  
 zoomValText.innerText = currentZoomLevel + "%";  
 tableCard.style.zoom = currentZoomLevel / 100;  
 }  
  
 function initTableResize() {  
 const resizer = document.getElementById('tableResizer');  
 const wrapper = document.getElementById('tableWrapper');  
 let startY, startHeight;  
  
 resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {  
 startY = e.clientY;  
 startHeight = parseInt(document.defaultView.getComputedStyle(wrapper).height, 10);  
 resizer.classList.add('active');  
 document.body.style.cursor = 'ns-resize';  
  
 document.addEventListener('mousemove', doResize);  
 document.addEventListener('mouseup', stopResize);  
 });  
  
 function doResize(e) {  
 const zoomFactor = currentZoomLevel / 100;  
 const diff = (e.clientY - startY) / zoomFactor;  
 wrapper.style.height = (startHeight + diff) + 'px';  
 }  
  
 function stopResize() {  
 resizer.classList.remove('active');  
 document.body.style.cursor = 'default';  
 document.removeEventListener('mousemove', doResize);  
 document.removeEventListener('mouseup', stopResize);  
 }  
 }  
  
 function removeVietnameseTones(str) {
   if (!str) return "";
   str = str.replace(/à|á|ạ|ả|ã|â|ầ|ấ|ậ|ẩ|ẫ|ă|ằ|ắ|ặ|ẳ|ẵ/g,"a"); 
   str = str.replace(/è|é|ẹ|ẻ|ẽ|ê|ề|ế|ệ|ể|ễ/g,"e"); 
   str = str.replace(/ì|í|ị|ỉ|ĩ/g,"i"); 
   str = str.replace(/ò|ó|ọ|ỏ|õ|ô|ồ|ố|ộ|ổ|ỗ|ơ|ờ|ớ|ợ|ở|ỡ/g,"o"); 
   str = str.replace(/ù|ú|ụ|ủ|ũ|ư|ừ|ứ|ự|ử|ữ/g,"u"); 
   str = str.replace(/ỳ|ý|ỵ|ỷ|ỹ/g,"y"); 
   str = str.replace(/đ/g,"d"); 
   str = str.replace(/À|Á|Ạ|Ả|Ã|Â|Ầ|Ấ|Ậ|Ẩ|Ẫ|Ă|Ằ|Ắ|Ặ|Ẳ|Ẵ/g, "A");
   str = str.replace(/È|É|Ẹ|Ẻ|Ẽ|Ê|Ề|Ế|Ệ|Ể|Ễ/g, "E");
   str = str.replace(/Ì|Í|Ị|Ỉ|Ĩ/g, "I");
   str = str.replace(/Ò|Ó|Ọ|Ỏ|Õ|Ô|Ồ|Ố|Ộ|Ổ|Ỗ|Ơ|Ờ|Ớ|Ợ|Ở|Ỡ/g, "O");
   str = str.replace(/Ù|Ú|Ụ|Ủ|Ũ|Ư|Ừ|Ứ|Ự|Ử|Ữ/g, "U");
   str = str.replace(/Ỳ|Ý|Ỵ|Ỷ|Ỹ/g, "Y");
   str = str.replace(/Đ/g, "D");
   str = str.replace(/\u0300|\u0301|\u0303|\u0309|\u0323/g, ""); 
   str = str.replace(/\u02C6|\u0306|\u031B/g, ""); 
   return str.trim();
 }

 function isErrorValue(val) {
   if (!val) return false;
   const str = val.toString().trim();
   if (str.startsWith("#")) return true;
   const errors = ["#n/a", "#value!", "#ref!", "#div/0!", "#num!", "#name?", "#null!"];
   return errors.includes(str.toLowerCase());
 }

 if (!data || data.length <= 1) return;  
   
 database = data;  
 hubMap = {};   
  
 let columnCValues = new Set();

 let hubName = database[i][4] ? database[i][4].toString().trim() : "";  
 let colCVal = database[i][2] ? database[i][2].toString().trim() : "";  
   
 if (isErrorValue(wardName) || isErrorValue(sortCode) || isErrorValue(hubName) || isErrorValue(colCVal)) {
   continue;
 }

 wardName = wardName.toUpperCase();
 sortCode = sortCode.toUpperCase();
 colCVal = colCVal.toUpperCase();
 hubName = hubName.trim();

 if (colCVal) {  
   columnCValues.add(colCVal);  
 }  
   
 if (hubName && wardName) {  
 if (!hubMap[hubName]) {  
 hubMap[hubName] = [];  
 }  
 if (!hubMap[hubName].some(item => item.ward === wardName)) {  
 hubMap[hubName].push({ ward: wardName, code: sortCode });  
 }  
 }  
 }  
  
 provinceList = Array.from(columnCValues).sort();
 const pInput = document.getElementById("headerProvinceInput");
 pInput.placeholder = "-- Chọn Tỉnh --";
   
 }).getRawDataFromSheet();

   }
 });
 });
